args.script:
cat > calculate_sum.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Get current date in seconds since epoch
current_date=$(date +%s)
seven_days_ago=$((current_date - 7 * 24 * 3600))

# Function to check if a number is prime
is_prime() {
    local n=$1
    if [ "$n" -lt 2 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [ "$n" -eq 2 ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ $((n % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local i=3
    while [ $((i * i)) -le "$n" ]; do
        if [ $((n % i)) -eq 0 ]; then
            return 1
        fi
        i=$((i + 2))
    done
    return 0
}

total_sum=0

for file in log_files/log_server_*.txt; do
    # Extract server ID and date from filename
    basename=$(basename "$file")
    # Format: log_server_X_YYYY-MM-DD.txt
    server_id=$(echo "$basename" | sed 's/log_server_\([0-9]*\)_\([0-9-]*\)\.txt/\1/')
    file_date=$(echo "$basename" | sed 's/log_server_\([0-9]*\)_\([0-9-]*\)\.txt/\2/')
    
    # Check if server ID is prime
    if is_prime "$server_id"; then
        # Check if file was created within last 7 days
        # Convert file date to epoch seconds
        file_epoch=$(date -d "$file_date" +%s 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$file_epoch" ] && [ "$file_epoch" -ge "$seven_days_ago" ]; then
            # Sum integers in the file
            file_sum=$(awk '{sum += $1} END {print sum}' "$file")
            total_sum=$((total_sum + file_sum))
        fi
    fi
done

echo "$total_sum"
EOF
chmod +x calculate_sum.sh
bash calculate_sum.sh
